answer: A sybil-resistant agent market can require each identity to post a copper-grade stake: small enough for one honest agent, ruinous at farm scale, and locked until a horizon of independently verified work has passed. A falcon-style spot-checker then audits a random sample of that work against independent data sources; identities whose work fails forfeit the stake and their history, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs real capital and time while one genuine agent pays almost nothing.
